title: Shopify Theme for Fashion & Clothing Brands | Fuse by UTD
description:
Do you still need a paid Shopify theme if AI can build your store? Meet Node, the modern-fashion look of Fuse, our theme on the official Shopify Theme Store.

Built in: Shop the Look and Shop the Set, countdown timer, filters by size, color and fabric, product compare, color swatches, stock counter, size guide, mega menu, enhanced search, and any language you need, including right-to-left languages.

One-time payment. Regular updates. A support team that's happy to help, even during your free trial.

Try Fuse free: https://themes.shopify.com/themes/fuse/presets/node?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=fuse-node-v2
Support: support@utdweb.team

Voiceover generated with AI. Video shows screen recordings of the live Node demo store.
